intervention.equal_norm_target: conventional checkpoint sample median L2 norm across positions 1..20; with 20 values this is the arithmetic mean of the 10th and 11th ordered norms
intervention.direction: preserve each nonzero fine-position unit direction
intervention.zero_control: set positions 0..20 to zero; descriptive only

estimands.lp: mean gold lexical-token log probability excluding EOS and padding

decision_rule.execution_invalid: Any lineage, cohort, checkpoint, intervention, repeat, restoration, finite, no-training/no-test, or resource-restoration check fails.
decision_rule.stop_no_structural_replication: Either dataset fails the locked exposure-norm correlation or position-20/position-1 norm-ratio gate.
decision_rule.stop_no_causal_benefit: Either dataset fails tail-miss mean, strict lower CI, or positive-rate gate.
decision_rule.stop_broad_harm: Either dataset has tail-hit mean below -0.01.
decision_rule.h1_design_allowed: All preceding gates pass on both datasets.

forbidden: mean-norm, clipping, partial-position, scale, threshold, cohort, or dataset scans after reading scores
using zero-position or one dataset to rescue a failed primary gate
